celsuslibrary.name: Library of Celsus
celsuslibrary.slogan: A two-storey facade that guarded 12,000 scrolls and a buried proconsul.
celsuslibrary.line: Built in honour of Tiberius Julius Celsus, who lies in a crypt beneath it, and rebuilt stone by stone between 1970 and 1978.

pergamonacropolis.name: Pergamon Acropolis
pergamonacropolis.slogan: Temples and a theatre stacked on a hilltop above Bergama.
pergamonacropolis.line: Its theatre, 36 metres high with 78 rows, is the steepest of all ancient theatres.

izmirclocktower.name: Izmir Clock Tower
izmirclocktower.slogan: The 25-metre filigree that tells Konak Square what time it is.
izmirclocktower.line: Raised in 1901 for Sultan Abdülhamid II's 25 years on the throne; its clock was a gift from Kaiser Wilhelm II.

kemeraltibazaar.name: Kemeraltı Bazaar
kemeraltibazaar.slogan: Hans, mosques and synagogues, all tangled into one bazaar maze.
kemeraltibazaar.line: The bazaar took shape between 1650 and 1670, when the shallow inner bay was filled in.

alacatiwindmills.name: Alaçatı Windmills
alacatiwindmills.slogan: Stone mills above lanes of whitewashed houses and a windy bay.
alacatiwindmills.line: These stone mills, more than 150 years old, were built to grind the village's wheat.
